Gaming · Player culture

The joy of playing together

Make room on the sofa. Some worlds are better shared.

By The Offbeat Edit · Culture Issue · 1 min read

A shared challenge

Playing together gives ordinary evenings a little structure: a shared challenge, a surprising mistake, and a reason to try one more time.

Welcome every player

Start with a game that welcomes everyone at the table. Explain one mechanic at a time, take breaks, and make space for different levels of experience. The point is a good evening together.

Choose a common goal

Cooperative games are useful when competition gets in the way. Pick a shared goal, talk through your plan, and celebrate the small saves as much as the final win.

Make room on the sofa. Some worlds are better shared.
